name: Oral Comprehension
basis: Speech recognition and language models follow ordinary speech, less well amid noise, several speakers or unstated context

name: Written Comprehension
basis: Language models read ordinary documents as well as a working person

name: Oral Expression
basis: Speech synthesis and language models speak clearly, less well in live exchange with people at work

name: Written Expression
basis: Language models write ordinary documents as well as a working person

name: Fluency of Ideas
basis: Language models produce many ideas on a topic at will

name: Originality
basis: Language models vary what is known more readily than they find what is new and apt

name: Problem Sensitivity
basis: Anomaly detection works where the signals are instrumented, not where something merely looks wrong

name: Deductive Reasoning
basis: Solvers and language models apply rules to stated problems, unreliably over long chains or loosely stated ones

name: Inductive Reasoning
basis: Statistical learning finds rules in data it is given, less well from a few scattered observations

name: Information Ordering
basis: Following a given rule to arrange things is what computers do

name: Category Flexibility
basis: Classifiers group things under any stated set of rules

name: Mathematical Reasoning
basis: Language models and solvers set up ordinary problems, with errors a checker must catch

name: Number Facility
basis: Arithmetic is what computers do

name: Memorization
basis: Storage and retrieval are what computers do

name: Speed of Closure
basis: Models make sense of cluttered inputs of kinds they were trained on

name: Flexibility of Closure
basis: Detection models find a known pattern in clutter, less well one described only once

name: Perceptual Speed
basis: Comparing figures, characters and patterns is fast and exact by machine

name: Spatial Orientation
basis: Positioning and mapping work outdoors and in mapped places, less well in new indoor ones

name: Visualization
basis: Geometry and simulation software predict rearrangements that have been modelled, not ones merely seen

name: Selective Attention
basis: A machine is not distracted

name: Time Sharing
basis: Machines run many tasks at once

name: Arm-Hand Steadiness
basis: Robot arms hold steadier than a hand

name: Manual Dexterity
basis: Robots grasp and assemble known parts in fixed cells, not varied objects in ordinary places

name: Finger Dexterity
basis: General-purpose robot hands do not yet handle small, varied objects as fingers do

name: Control Precision
basis: Servo control sets positions more exactly than a person

name: Multilimb Coordination
basis: Legged and two-armed robots coordinate limbs in demonstrations, not yet across ordinary work

name: Response Orientation
basis: Choosing among responses to a signal is fast by machine

name: Rate Control
basis: Tracking a moving target is ordinary control engineering

name: Reaction Time
basis: Machines react faster than people

name: Wrist-Finger Speed
basis: Actuators repeat small movements faster than people

name: Speed of Limb Movement
basis: Actuators move faster than limbs

name: Static Strength
basis: Machines are stronger

name: Explosive Strength
basis: Machines are stronger

name: Dynamic Strength
basis: Machines do not tire

name: Trunk Strength
basis: Machines do not tire

name: Stamina
basis: Machines do not tire

name: Extent Flexibility
basis: Arms reach and bend within a designed workspace, less well into cluttered or cramped places

name: Dynamic Flexibility
basis: Arms repeat reaching movements within a designed workspace

name: Gross Body Coordination
basis: Legged robots move the whole body in demonstrations, not yet across ordinary work

name: Gross Body Equilibrium
basis: Legged robots keep their balance on ordinary ground, less reliably on what is unstable or unseen

name: Near Vision
basis: Cameras resolve close detail

name: Far Vision
basis: Cameras resolve distant detail

name: Visual Color Discrimination
basis: Cameras and colorimeters tell colours apart

name: Night Vision
basis: Low-light and infrared cameras see in the dark

name: Peripheral Vision
basis: Cameras cover any field of view

name: Depth Perception
basis: Stereo cameras and laser ranging measure distance

name: Glare Sensitivity
basis: Cameras are still blinded by strong light more easily than eyes

name: Hearing Sensitivity
basis: Microphones resolve pitch and loudness

name: Auditory Attention
basis: Separating one voice or sound from many works in part

name: Sound Localization
basis: Microphone arrays locate a sound

name: Speech Recognition
basis: Speech recognition transcribes ordinary speech about as well as a listener

name: Speech Clarity
basis: Speech synthesis is clear
